description: This file defines the Amazon Machine Learning client class for the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends the base AwsClient and includes method annotations for various AWS Machine Learning operations, as well as a constructor that modifies the request handler to allow changing the endpoint for predictions.

classes.name: MachineLearningClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Machine Learning service, allowing operation calls and endpoint customization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client and appends a custom handler to modify the Predict endpoint if needed.

methods.name: predictEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a handler that modifies the URI of Predict commands to use a specified endpoint.
